rules.statement: The arbitration clause in the partnership deed does not cover disputes involving a dissolution of the partnership, especially when fraud is alleged.
rules.supporting_quote: "In my opinion the order of the District Judge staying proceedings should be set aside and the case sent back, plaintiff A.C. J. being at liberty to apply for the appointment of a receiver pending action; the costs of the appeal and of the order in the District Court to be paid by the respondents."
